title: Are We Moving Towards Chaos?
summary: Chaos is the inherent unpredictability of the behavior of a natural system. Volatility is therefore a measure of chaos. The following chart shows that the short-term swings between highs and lows for Aframax earnings are becoming more pronounced.

children.summary: While the standard deviation for Panamaxes trading Caribs upcoast accompanied the increasing volatility with Aframaxes during the first two cycles, volatility has remained essentially unchanged during the last cycle. For Handymaxes trading Caribs upcoast, the trend is up, but far more subdued than that for Panamaxes and Aframaxes.
